stances.summary: Praises utility workers for storm recovery efforts
stances.quote:
Today, thousands of utility workers are deployed across the state repairing power lines and clearing debris from yesterday's storms.

To everyone working hard to restore power: thank you. I'm extremely grateful for everything you're doing to keep Michiganders safe.

stances.summary: Highlights I-275 reconstruction as infrastructure improvement
stances.quote:
For nearly 50 years, I-275 was patched and repatched. Now, we’ve rebuilt 24 miles of road and 65 bridges — making your commute to work or your trip to see family smoother and safer.

Same road. A whole different ride. https://t.co/ZEitZrIHI1

stances.summary: Touts road infrastructure innovation and safety improvements
stances.quote:
I-96's flex route in Oakland County just earned a national award for innovation. Since it opened, crashes are down 37% & commutes are more reliable in both directions. That's why we’re fixing the damn roads. 
https://t.co/pVGKRvME2k

stances.summary: Urges disaster victims to apply for federal aid before deadline
stances.quote:
If you experienced damage from April's storms, tornadoes, or flooding, the deadline to apply for FEMA's Individual Assistance program or an SBA low-interest disaster loan is Mon., 8/31 at 11:59 p.m.

Apply here: https://t.co/1yPgES9Yn0

stances.summary: Urges disaster victims to access federal recovery assistance
stances.quote:
April's storms, tornadoes, and flooding hit families across our state hard.

Reminder: You have one week left—until Aug. 31—to apply for FEMA assistance or an SBA disaster loan. Over $28M has already helped more than 5,000 Michiganders recover. Apply now: https://t.co/1yPgES9Yn0

stances.summary: Opposes hydroelectric dam sale, cites safety and financial risks
stances.quote: We deserve a deal that’s better than what’s on the table. The proposed sale of 13 old hydro dams threatens our rivers and imposes unacceptable safety and financial risks on Michiganders.

stances.summary: Aligns with environmental groups opposing dam sale
stances.quote:
I'm grateful to have the Anglers of the Au Sable, Great Lakes Council of Fly Fishers International, Michigan Steelhead and Salmon Fishermen's Association, Michigan Trout Unlimited & Michigan Hydro Relicensing Coalition standing with me. 
elpc.org/news/statement-of-m…

stances.summary: Touts road repair accomplishments, job creation
stances.quote:
I said I'd fix the damn roads. We're getting it done.

Since taking office through the end of this construction season, we will have repaired or replaced 26,500+ lane miles and 2,000 bridges, supporting tens of thousands of good paying construction jobs along the way.

stances.summary: Praises road workers, emphasizes infrastructure maintenance
stances.quote: Across the state, Michigan's hard working road crews are paving the way to smoother roads -- one lane at a time. Today, let's thank every road worker putting in the time to create nicer and safer roads for everyone.

stances.summary: Opposes dam sale without added safety safeguards
stances.quote:
Private dam owners cutting corners have already cost Michiganders their homes and their safety. I'm formally opposing Consumers Energy's sale of 13 dams to Confluence Hydro unless it comes with added safeguards.

Michiganders shouldn't bear these risks.

detroitnews.com/story/new

stances.summary: Launches Housing Opportunity Tax Credit to build 2,500 affordable units annually
stances.quote:
Amidst a national housing shortage, we’re opening the doors to build, baby, build right here in Michigan.

This year, we’re creating a Housing Opportunity Tax Credit that paves the way for building an extra 2,500 affordable units per year.

stances.summary: Enacted affordable housing tax credit and reduced regulatory barriers
stances.quote:
In my State of the State address earlier this year, I outlined my plan to make housing more accessible to Michiganders. I called for slashing red tape and creating a statewide affordable housing tax credit.

5 months later, I'm proud to say that we got it done.

stances.summary: Opposes Trump tariffs as reckless, harmful to Michigan families
stances.quote:
While Washington D.C. inflames a trade war with Canada, Michiganders are continuing to the pay the price.

Higher costs. Increased uncertainty. Hardworking Michigan families fighting to get by.

I've been consistent since day 1: these tariffs are reckless, and we deserve better.

stances.summary: Suing to block Trump tariffs; criticizes GOP reckless trade policy
GOP tariffs harm Michigan families through retaliatory trade escalation
stances.quote: Now, new U.S. tariffs will lead to new Canadian retaliatory tariffs and increase the pressure on Michigan families. While Republicans in DC alienate our allies, Michiganders are the ones paying the cost. It's unacceptable.

stances.summary: Demands end to reckless federal tariff policies
stances.quote: I'm grateful for Michael and the other hardworking Michiganders speaking up and making their voices heard on this issue. The reckless federal tariff policies must end.

stances.summary: GOP tariff policies worsening threat to Michigan businesses, families
stances.quote:
Early last year, I highlighted Michael's story because reckless DC Republicans’ tariff policies were endangering Michigan businesses and families. Fast forward, and the concerns have only gotten worse.

https://t.co/Ldbawk73Fr

stances.summary: GOP tariff gamesmanship forcing layoffs and price increases
stances.quote: Companies – especially our auto manufacturers – face the difficult decision of laying off workers or passing costs onto their customers, who are already suffering because of the GOP’s gamesmanship. This must end.

stances.summary: Republican tariff taxes unaffordable for Michigan families
stances.quote: Michiganders literally cannot afford to keep paying these Republican tariff taxes.

stances.summary: DC Republicans' tariff wars act as tax hike on Michigan
stances.quote: Michiganders are uniquely impacted by DC Republicans’ ongoing, chaotic tariff wars with Canada. These tariffs act as a tax hike on Michigan families and businesses by raising prices at the grocery store and the gas pump.

stances.summary: Defends tax cuts on overtime, tips, and social security earnings
stances.quote: When money is tight, every penny counts. That’s why I cut taxes on overtime, tips, and social security – because Michiganders who work hard for their money deserve to keep every penny they can.

stances.summary: Criticizes Republican tariffs for raising food costs on Michigan families
stances.quote:
DC Republicans’ reckless tariffs are raising costs for Michigan families—and new reports from my administration show just how much.
 
Over the last year:
 
🥩 Meat, poultry, and fish prices rose 6.2% 🍎 Fruit and vegetable prices rose 6.1% 🛒 Overall food prices rose 3.1%

stances.summary: Opposes tariff policies, backs commonsense trade approach supporting workers
stances.quote: Michigan businesses shouldn’t have to choose between raising prices, cutting jobs, or absorbing costs they can’t afford. And working families shouldn’t be stuck paying the bill for Washington’s reckless trade policies.

stances.summary: Michigan joins court challenge against federal tariffs
stances.quote:
That’s why Michigan joined nearly two dozen states challenging these tariffs in court.

I’ll keep fighting for a commonsense trade policy that lowers costs, supports Michigan businesses and workers, and provides families with stability.

Read the reports: michigan.gov/whitmer/new

stances.summary: Highlights education funding increases and student support programs
stances.quote:
Whether your kid is 5 or 15, back to school is easier on Michigan families this year.

Free breakfast and lunch for every student. Record per-pupil funding. A 12x increase in mental health support.

From free pre-K to money towards college, we've got them covered. https://t.co/4R

stances.summary: Expands tuition-free education access by lowering age requirements
stances.quote: We’ve expanded Michigan Reconnect, now residents 21 and older can apply—which used to start at age 25. Almost 20,000 graduates have used this tuition-free path to a degree or skills certificate. Age shouldn't stand between anyone and their future. Apply: https://t.co/PR2iRfGvyq

stances.summary: Announces new education funding and classroom investments for Michigan students
stances.quote:
With Back to School season on the horizon, we’re giving Michigan students and teachers some major new investments for when they return to the classroom.

Here’s what we’ve done since last school year:

stances.summary: Supports expanding tuition-free higher education access
stances.quote:
A great education opens doors - that's why we’re lowering the cost of higher ed to ensure more Michiganders are set up for success.

This year, we're expanding Michigan reconnect to learners 21 or older, giving more Michiganders a tuition-free pathway to a higher education.

stances.summary: Highlights local progress on health and infrastructure
stances.quote:
I am honored to receive the key to the city of Flint -- birthplace of the RxKids program, future home of MI's newest state park, and we replaced the lead service lines.

The driving force behind that progress is Flint’s people. We're building a brighter future, together.

stances.summary: Highlights balanced budgets and responsible economic growth record
stances.quote:
When I took office 7.5 years ago, growing Michigan’s economy responsibly was one of my top priorities.

Fast forward to 2026, and I’ve now signed 8 balanced, bipartisan budgets that have set Michigan up for a brighter future. Here’s why that matters. 👇

stances.summary: Credits fiscal management improvements and public investments
stances.quote:
Together we've improved upon the state’s fiscal record by increasing the rainy-day fund, paying down debt, and strengthening Michigan’s credit rating.

Plus, we've invested in our schools, grown our economy, and lowered costs for Michiganders.

stances.summary: Claims improved state finances under her administration
stances.quote: After 8 budgets, we’re leaving Michigan’s finances better than we found them.

stances.summary: Highlights balanced budget accomplishments through humor
stances.quote:
Michigan: it’s Shark Week!

Anyone who knows me knows that I love 2 things: Shark Week and a balanced, bipartisan budget. Why not combine them?

Scroll through to see what your favorite shark (and their matching budget win!) says about you.

stances.summary: Supports bills to aid first responders and expand emergency alerts
stances.quote:
Since my first day in office, protecting Michiganders has been a top priority.

Yesterday, I was proud to reinforce this commitment with a series of bills that support first responders and expand emergency alert systems - because everyone deserves to be safe here in Michigan.

stances.summary: Continuing fight to stop Enbridge Line 5 oil pipeline
stances.quote: Today, I’m continuing my 7-year fight on Line 5 to stop Enbridge from pumping oil through the Great Lakes. https://t.co/UPzFonleJh

stances.summary: Michigan investing in parks and conservation projects statewide
stances.quote: Big news for our public lands: we just secured $45 million in Trust Fund grants for 75 parks and conservation projects statewide, including protecting nearly 22,650 acres in the Keweenaw Peninsula. That's Michigan investing in the outdoors we love. https://t.co/Q58nlujLal

stances.summary: Suing Republicans to protect absentee voting rights in Michigan
stances.quote: Republicans in DC are trying to make it harder for you to vote, but we're suing to protect absentee voting here in Michigan. Attorney General Nessel and I are committed to protecting your rights. https://t.co/cVGbsatDLI

stances.summary: Encourages voter registration and participation in upcoming election
stances.quote: 106 years ago today, the 19th Amendment gave women the right to vote. Michigan helped lead the way, ratifying it early. The best way to honor that fight? VOTE! Register at https://t.co/S6Z636Fgk9 before Nov. 3.

stances.summary: Criticizes Republican SNAP cuts to fund tax breaks for wealthy
stances.quote:
145,000+ Michiganders have lost food assistance since DC Republicans cut SNAP to fund tax breaks for the wealthy when they passed the Big Beautiful Bill. One of every three is a child.

No one should go to bed hungry, we deserve better from Washington. 
 
michiganadvance.com/2026

stances.summary: Celebrates passage of balanced, bipartisan budget
stances.quote:
71 bills. 60+ minutes of signing. 1 balanced, bipartisan budget.
 
Ever wondered how a budget gets signed? Here's a sneak peek:

stances.summary: Celebrates LGBTQ+ workplace and housing discrimination protections
stances.quote: August is Michigan's first Transgender and Non-Binary Pride and History Month. That didn't happen in a vacuum. In 2023, I signed a law that finally protects LGBTQ+ people from losing their job or home just for who they are. That's the Michigan we built. https://t.co/XGuZF3B0fR

stances.summary: State funding military base jobs and infrastructure expansion
stances.quote: Selfridge pulls in $850 million a year for our economy and backs 30,000 jobs statewide. Today we're putting more into it: $5.9M for a new lab (100+ construction jobs right there), plus $3.6M to train shipbuilders. More jobs, more investment, more Michigan-made.

stances.summary: Promotes gun seizure operation, credits crime reduction success
stances.quote:
Over 1,000 illegal guns off Michigan streets.

That's Operation Safe Neighborhoods: state and local law enforcement working together to get guns out of the wrong hands, part of the effort that's helped drive violent crime down 11% over the last 5 years.

stances.summary: Highlights Michigan dairy production and corporate investment
stances.quote:
MI cows produce more milk per cow than any other U.S. state. 🐄🥇
 
When @fairlife needed the good stuff for their $650M Coopersville investment, they knew where to look. ~200 new jobs, 2 new lines, powered by the hardest-working cows in America. That's the Michigan difference.

stances.quote:
